blurb: Mr. Drago earned his Bachelor's in English and Theatre and his Master's in English from Northern Arizona University. His stage credits span more than 45 years. Prior to moving to North Carolina, he directed and performed in plays and musicals for high school, college, and community theatres while living in New York City, then Phoenix. His stage debut was the title role in The Wizard of Oz.
